source: FINRA ATS Transparency historical download archive
workflow: Phase 535 - FINRA ATS archive access and schema audit
key_findings: Official FINRA guide documents weekly security-by-ATS reports, downloadable archive index, machine-download table tblTrading, and data fields including Shares_Last_Updated and Trades_Last_Updated.
First ATS weekly reports covered 2014-05-12 to 2014-05-16; potential history start predates weeklySummaryHistoric API.
T1 reports have a nominal two-week delay; T2 and OTC reports a four-week delay; Phase100 API sample observed 21/35 calendar-day initial publication lags.
2015 FINRA rule filing removed the 2014 ATS data fees and made ATS data public at no charge effective 2015-07-13; user certification/terms still apply.
blocksSummary is ATS/MPID/month aggregate and has no security identifier; stock-selection block hypotheses killed.

pit.rule: No backdating final revised snapshots to report week; reconcile update dates with API initialPublishedDate/lastUpdateDate and first-seen captures.
